exposure: Ethylenethiourea (ETU) gavage-fed (125 mg/kg) on gestational day 10
outcome: Differential expression of microRNAs (miRNAs) in hindgut tissue
cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats (n=36) and their embryos/fetuses, divided into ETU-treated and control groups.
finding: Three specific miRNAs (miR-125b-2-3p, miR-92a-2-5p, and miR-99a-5p) were significantly differentially expressed in rats with ETU-induced ARMs compared to the normal group.
